title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research

claim.summary: Quant-Arena has LLMs write feature and stock-scoring code over raw daily and Level-2 A-share data, revise it with bounded research-period feedback, and freeze one strategy that a cash-account evaluator assesses on a sealed out-of-sample year.

modules.name: Date-scoped market data interface
modules.scope_reason: Access is gated by decision date, instrument and field with identical rules in research and assessment, a point-in-time availability constraint that would serve a forecasting or other market-series task without redesign.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "Missing observations and delisted stocks"

modules.name: Bounded research loop with sealed-year assessment
modules.scope_reason: Feedback, the frozen deliverable and the sealed evaluator are defined around a stock-scoring program converted to a top-75 equal-weight cash-account portfolio, so the protocol is bound to the trading-strategy output contract.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "Models may evaluate candidate strategies"
